meta.name: wiki-ingest
meta.description: Ingest articles, PDFs, videos, transcripts, and notes into a persistent interlinked knowledge wiki and V6 knowledge operating system. Use when the user wants source notes, entity pages, concept pages, navigation updates, STOW processing, Obsidian provenance, clipping lifecycle handling, or supervised promotion of source-derived insights into skills, SOPs, schemas, daily loops, or governance queues.
